title: First Lessons
description: The player seeks to join the College of Winterhold. Faralda tests them with a spell at the bridge, Mirabelle Ervine gives them a tour of the grounds, and Tolfdir teaches them about ward spells before announcing an expedition to Saarthal.

base_facts: I guard the bridge to the College of Winterhold and test anyone who wishes to enter.
I require applicants to demonstrate magical ability by casting a spell before I let them cross.

ENTRANCE_EXAM: The applicant passed my spell test and was allowed to cross the bridge.
ADMITTED_TO_COLLEGE: I directed the new member to speak with Mirabelle Ervine inside the College.

base_facts: I am the Master-Wizard of the College of Winterhold and handle new arrivals.
I give tours of the College grounds to new members.

TOUR_WITH_MIRABELLE: I gave the new apprentice a tour of the College and provided them with novice robes and quarters in the Hall of Attainment.
TOLFDIR_LECTURE: I directed the new apprentice to attend Tolfdir's lecture in the Hall of the Elements.

base_facts: I am an elderly professor at the College of Winterhold who teaches the apprentices.
I believe in the importance of safety and mitigation when practicing magic.

TOLFDIR_LECTURE: I taught the new apprentice about ward spells and gave them Lesser Ward.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The apprentice successfully used a ward against my firebolt. I proposed an expedition to Saarthal and consider them a friend.
Player successfully defends with a ward; Tolfdir announces the Saarthal expedition.
If one of the three students die by any means, Tolfdir will cancel the ward training and immediately start the next quest.
Most of the other optional quests do not become available until after the next quest, Under Saarthal , has been completed.

beats.comment: Player discovers the College and must seek entry.
Faralda demands the player cast a spell to prove their ability.
Player is admitted and directed to Mirabelle Ervine.
Mirabelle gives the player a tour of the College facilities.
Player attends Tolfdir's lecture and learns about ward spells.
Player successfully defends with a ward; Tolfdir announces the Saarthal expedition.
